reviews.text: AMAZING customer service!!! I had an issue with my pool on July 4th…of course!  The local Leslie’s did not have the part I needed nor did ANY Leslie’s in the DFW area. I found The Pool Store online and gave them a call. Just by happenstance Scott was at the store and answered…even though they were CLOSED for the holiday. Then he asked what part I was looking for!  He had the part, asked where I was coming from, and said he would wait for me to get there…which was about 20 minutes. I am beyond THANKFUL for Scott and I can not remember the last time I have experienced such GREAT customer service. Although The Pool Store is not convenient for me to visit, you have earned my future business with this experience!  THANK YOU, THE POOL STORE and THANK YOU, SCOTT!!!
reviews.author: Russell Ellis

reviews.text: Best pool store in town. Prices are reasonable. Employees are knowledgeable. Owner is very hands on, and willing to help fix anything that might go wrong with your pool. Highly recommend using them.
reviews.author: Mahmoud Elsayed

reviews.text:
Noticed the new sign and decided to check them out by getting my water tested.  Happily discovered they are a familiar team to Coppell pool owners and are locally owned, unlike the big brand.
The prices are more competitive than the big brand and I know from experience they will not try to sell you anything you don't need.  Win-win-win.  Coppell finally has another convenient, knowledgeable and trustworthy resource for pool owners. I highly recommend you give them a try.
reviews.author: Rick Yery

reviews.text: It’s great to have a true neighborhood pool store locally.  After a big “chain” bought the last local store in Coppell, there was really no trusted option.  The Pool Store is like having a true friend helping you with your pool needs.  Thanks for opening and bringing trust to the area to help pool owners.
reviews.author: Craig O

data.summary: The reviews are highly positive and lack any critical feedback, which is unusual. However, the content of the reviews is detailed, varied, and emotionally authentic, strongly suggesting real customer experiences. The low volume and perfect score are more indicative of a new, well-liked local business than a pattern of fakery.
fake_signals: Several reviews posted around the same time (a year ago)
authentic_signals: Reviews contain specific details (holiday service, part searches, competitor names)
Varied writing styles and customer perspectives
Mentions of local ownership and community need
